rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Rent Control coverage
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases. Rent control does not apply to new construction that received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums, certain subsidized units, and exempt unit types.
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996; rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases). Includes units with Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8), Shelter Plus Care, VASH Voucher, LIHTC, California Community Housing Agency, HOME, City of Berkeley Housing Trust Fund, Mental Health Safety Act subsidies, and Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, Project-based Section 8 subsidies if the project does not have a mortgage insured or held by HUD.
rules.exemptions: Not under rent control (partially covered): new construction built and receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996; most condominiums; units with Section 202 or Section 811 subsidies; units with Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, or Project-based Section 8 subsidies in a project with a mortgage insured or held by HUD. Fully exempt: Golden Duplex (duplex owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently with an owner living in one unit); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance - Just Cause for Eviction coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction protections apply to both fully covered and partially covered units, including new construction, post-1996 single-family tenancies, most condominiums and listed subsidized units. Golden Duplexes, owner-shared kitchen or bath units, certain ADU properties, university dormitories and nonprofit cooperatives are exempt.
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered and partially covered units: multifamily units built before 1980; single family homes (any tenancy start date); rooming houses; new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; most condominiums; units with listed government subsidies.
rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex (duplex owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently with an owner living in one unit); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
